planned_path.path_summary: Regress Manifesto-method plurality-winner distance from the median voter on an SMD indicator, adjusting for decade fixed effects and clustering standard errors by country.

path_signature.sample_restriction: Rows with election rule coded smd or pr and nonmissing variables required by the model.
path_signature.missing_data_rule: Listwise deletion for pldist1, smd, decade, and country.
path_signature.variable_construction: Clean smd labels, create binary SMD indicator, create categorical decade.
path_signature.inference_rule: Expected direction is negative. Expected direction with p <= 0.05 is support; 0.05 < p <= 0.055 is borderline support only for a meaningful estimate whose interval narrowly crosses the null; clearly weak aligned evidence is inconclusive; affirmative positive coefficient with p < 0.05 and interval above zero is opposite.
path_signature.estimand_quantity: Decade-adjusted coefficient on smd_bin from OLS, interpreted as the mean difference in pldist1 for SMD versus PR elections conditional on decade.
path_signature.contrast: SMD election-rule observations versus PR election-rule observations.
path_signature.target_population: Authorized Powell election observations with smd or pr election-rule coding.

execution_result.status_reason: The agent followed the planned Task1 path exactly: pldist1 was regressed on smd_bin with decade fixed effects and country-clustered standard errors. No implementation repairs or analysis changes were made.

planned_path.path_summary: Use all authorized observations with smd or pr election-rule coding and estimate whether SMD elections have a lower median Manifesto-method plurality-winner distance from the median voter than PR elections.

path_signature.sample_restriction: Rows in the authorized dataset with smd coded as smd or pr and nonmissing required focal variables.
path_signature.missing_data_rule: Listwise deletion for pldist1, smd, and year.
path_signature.variable_construction: No scaling or categorization of pldist1; smd is cleaned and converted to a binary SMD-versus-PR contrast.
path_signature.inference_rule: Expected direction is negative. Support requires a negative SMD coefficient with p <= 0.05, or borderline support for 0.05 < p <= 0.055 when the estimate is substantively meaningful and the interval narrowly crosses zero. A positive coefficient is opposite only with affirmative p < 0.05 evidence and an interval above zero; otherwise inconclusive.
path_signature.estimand_quantity: SMD-minus-PR difference in the conditional median of pldist1.
path_signature.contrast: SMD election-rule observations versus PR election-rule observations.
path_signature.target_population: Authorized Powell election observations with smd/pr election-rule coding and nonmissing pldist1, smd, and year.

deviations.candidate_choice: Median quantile regression of pldist1 on smd_bin.
deviations.justification: The focal claim concerns closeness to the median voter, and the inspected pldist1 distribution is continuous and right-skewed. A median contrast is a minimal, defensible robustness change that preserves outcome, contrast, sample, and inference while avoiding duplication of the prior OLS path.

execution_result.status_reason: The agent followed the planned Task1 path exactly: authorized Stata data, pldist1 outcome, SMD-versus-PR contrast, listwise deletion for required variables, and median quantile regression. No repairs or implementation deviations were required.
